content:
Carlos has Mesa Vista 4C down as wrapped from its June turn and wants it released for listing. Brooke is ready to put it on the market on his word. I am not signing off on it until I have run my own pass, so before anyone lists it I need the real state of that turn.

The unit moved out in the middle of June with a target-ready date at the end of the month, which has already come and gone. The two scopes that carried this turn were the deep clean and the interior repaint. I need to know whether both are genuinely closed and signed off or still open, and I want the vendor side reconciled too. A scope that is billed but not finished, or finished with the bill still sitting unpaid, does not count as closed to me. There is also a re-inspection on the calendar for the middle of this month, and it factors into whether I can call this one done.

When you have the actual picture, record your QC determination on that turn and give me the call: if it is genuinely marketing-ready, sign it off; if it is not, say so plainly and hold it, because it does not go to listing until every outstanding scope is closed and signed off. Open a ticket on the issue tracker spelling out exactly what is still left on it, post where it lands in the make-ready channel, and get an email together for Carlos with the specifics. If I am holding it back, Brooke needs to hear it from us before she markets it.
I will inspect local files, Airtable make-ready records, Slack channels, Google Calendar, and QuickBooks bills to gather all
facts regarding the turnover state of Mesa Vista 4C.

parameters.body:
Hi Carlos,

I am writing to update you on the turnover status for Mesa Vista Unit 4C following my Quality Control review. While I know you were looking to wrap up the June turn and have Brooke release the unit for listing, I am placing a Quality Control HOLD on Mesa Vista 4C and will not sign off on marketing release at this time.

Here are the specific details and requirements behind this determination:

1. Unpaid Vendor Bills (QuickBooks Reconciliation):
   - Deep Clean (Sunshine Cleaning / Carmen Delgado): Invoice #2026-SC-4C for $387.00 is logged in QuickBooks but remains sitting UNPAID (Balance: $387.00).
   - Interior Repaint (Pete Donovan / Permian Make-Ready Crew): Invoice #PD-2026-09 for $1,340.00 is logged in QuickBooks but remains sitting UNPAID (Balance: $1,340.00).
   *Per Star PM Quality Control standards, a turnover scope with an outstanding/unpaid bill or unverified completion is not considered closed.*

2. Pending Calendar Re-Inspection:
   - An official "Make-Ready QC Inspection - Mesa Vista 4C" is scheduled on the calendar for Wednesday, July 15, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 10:45 AM.
   - Final QC sign-off cannot occur prior to this walkthrough. During this inspection, I will also verify the in-house punch list work completed by Tony (kitchen faucet cartridge, bathroom GFCI outlet swap, drywall patching).

3. Listing Release Restriction:
   - Brooke (CC'd here) must hold back on putting Unit 4C on the market until every outstanding vendor scope is paid/reconciled and Quality Control provides official sign-off post-July 15 inspection.

I have logged these requirements in Linear ticket OPS-1000 and updated the Airtable Make-Ready record accordingly. Let's get the QuickBooks vendor payments processed so we are ready for the July 15 walkthrough.

Best regards,

Jaime Salinas
Quality Control Inspector
Star Property Management
